research_metadata.coverage_notes: Initial research focused on prominent constituent and community campuses affiliated with Tribhuvan University within Okhaldhunga district. Additional research is ongoing for minor private and CTEVT-affiliated technical campuses.

identity.name: Okhaldhunga Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: Okhaldhunga Multiple Campus is a leading community-based higher education institution in the Okhaldhunga district, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Okhaldhunga Multiple Campus, established in 1980, is located in Siddhigachhi, Okhaldhunga. It offers various undergraduate and education programs under Tribhuvan University, serving students from the remote hilly regions of Koshi Province.

recognition_details: Recognized by University Grants Commission (UGC) Nepal

academics.academic_calendar: As per Tribhuvan University academic calendar
academics.teaching_methodology: Lectures, practical sessions, assignments, and interactive discussions.

programs.name: Bachelor of Arts (BA)
programs.eligibility: Passed 10+2 or equivalent examination from a recognized board.

programs.name: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed)
programs.eligibility: Passed 10+2 or equivalent examination with minimum required marks.

admission.guidance: Admissions open annually following Tribhuvan University's admission guidelines.
requirements: Completed 10+2 or equivalent from recognized board
application_process: Obtain application form from campus administration
Submit filled form along with necessary documents
admission.entrance_details: Entrance examination may be required based on TU guidelines for specific faculties.

scholarships.name: UGC Formula Funding Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Underprivileged, meritorious, and reserved category students.
scholarships.benefits: Partial or full tuition fee waiver.

faculty.teaching_approach: Traditional lecture method combined with student-centric discussions.

institutional_profile.mission: To provide accessible, quality higher education to the youth of Okhaldhunga and surrounding hilly regions.
institutional_profile.vision: To develop the campus into a recognized center of academic excellence.
